hero.prompt: Studio product render of a six-axis industrial robot arm, three-quarter side view, arm raised and bent at the elbow with a two-finger gripper reaching to the right. Satin dark graphite grey metal housings with soft white rim highlights, a small bright orange "{brand}" logo in a blocky techno typeface on the forearm, black cylindrical base with white trim. Plain flat medium-dark grey seamless background (#3a3a3a), soft diffused top light, 85mm lens, minimal, no other objects, no text besides the logo.

closeup.prompt: Extreme close-up product photo of the wrist and forearm of a white industrial robot arm entering from the left edge, a thin red-orange anodized ring at the wrist joint and a metallic two-finger gripper pointing right. A small orange "{brand}" logo printed on the white forearm shell. Pure black background, hard rim light from above, crisp reflections, high contrast, 100mm macro lens.

cutout.prompt: Isolated side view of a robot forearm and two-finger gripper pointing right, matte mid-grey plastic shell with a dark "{brand}" logo, black flexible cable arching over the top, metallic finger joints. Flat even studio lighting, transparent background, no shadow.

environment.prompt: Top-down black and white photograph of an automated factory floor: long parallel conveyor lines with rows of small white robot arms working along them, pipes and metal grating, strong vertical lines, high contrast, harsh overhead light, documentary industrial photography.

lineart.prompt: Technical contour line drawing of a six-axis industrial robot arm seen from a low three-quarter angle, arm curving up and forward with a gripper at the top left, round base at the bottom. Thin pure white outlines only on a pure black background, no shading, no fill, no text, clean vector engineering illustration, subject fills the frame.

sprite.prompt: Sprite sheet for animation: a 2 by 2 grid of four equal cells on a pure white background, each cell shows the SAME two-finger industrial robot gripper in side view pointing right, drawn as thin black technical outline line art with no shading. Same position, scale and framing in every cell; only the fingers change: cell 1 top-left fully closed, cell 2 top-right slightly open, cell 3 bottom-left half open, cell 4 bottom-right wide open. No grid lines, no numbers, no text.
